headline: Medellin Metro Launches Estacion 77 Real Estate Development Project
summary: Medellin Metro presented its first real estate project, Estacion 77 – Ciudad Peldar, featuring 1,122 homes and a shopping mall next to the Envigado station.
why: Transit-oriented real estate developments diversify revenue streams for public mass transit operators.

impacts.name: Medellin Metro
impacts.why: Real estate diversification projects contribute commercial property revenues.
